confession: Extra-judicial confession of co-accused, but retracted and deemed unreliable
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder and criminal breach of trust, sentenced to death, life imprisonment, and 10 years rigorous imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Commuting death sentence to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused were involved in an incident where a tractor owner was shot and his tractor was taken. The prosecution relied on an extra-judicial confession made by one of the accused, which was delayed and made to a person from a distant village. The confession was retracted, and the accused denied making it. The recovery of a country made pistol and tractor parts was delayed, raising doubts about their evidentiary value. The trial court convicted the accused of murder and criminal breach of trust, while the High Court commuted the death sentence to life imprisonment. The Supreme Court found the confession unreliable and the evidence insufficient to sustain the conviction, leading to the acquittal of the accused.
